Retention

Retention has been measured on a consistent basis across the periods shown. Gross retention excludes expansion; net retention includes expansion, upsell and contraction within the existing base.

Gross revenue retention, FY22: 87.0 percent
Gross revenue retention, FY23: 88.0 percent
Gross revenue retention, FY24: 88.8 percent
Gross revenue retention, FY25: 89.0 percent
Net revenue retention, FY22: 92.0 percent
Net revenue retention, FY23: 94.3 percent
Net revenue retention, FY24: 96.0 percent
Net revenue retention, FY25: 97.0 percent

Gross and net revenue retention, FY22 to FY25.

Note: chart values are read off the axis (units: percent) and are approximate.
